title: SPECIAL ACT ON THE RESTORATION AND MAINTENANCE OF KEY HISTORIC SITES OF THE SILLA ROYAL CAPITAL
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the establishment of national identity by reviving the original form of the culture of the Korean people through the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital, a precious cultural asset of the Korean people, and to the development of Gyeongju, where the Silla Royal Capital is located, into a vibrant city of history and culture.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. The term "Silla Royal Capital" refers to the capital during the Silla and Unified Silla periods and means Gyeongju and its surrounding areas, where the king principally resided and governed.
2. The term "key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital" means the historic sites within the Silla Royal Capital prescribed by Presidential Decree, including the Silla royal palace [hereinafter referred to as "Wolseong"], Hwangnyongsa Temple, Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond, and Cheomseongdae Observatory.

Article 3 (Responsibilities of the State and Local Governments)
(1) The State and local governments shall cooperate with each other to carry out the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital smoothly and efficiently, and shall endeavor to ensure the successful implementation of such restoration and maintenance.
(2) The State and local governments shall endeavor, by formulating funding plans and taking other such measures, to ensure that the financial support necessary for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital is provided so that such restoration and maintenance can be carried out on a stable basis.

Article 4 (Relationship with Other Acts)
(1) This Act shall apply in preference to other Acts with respect to the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital.
(2) Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital shall be governed by the Special Act on the Preservation and Promotion of Ancient Cities.

Article 5 (Formulation of a Comprehensive Plan for the Restoration and Maintenance of Key Historic Sites of the Silla Royal Capital)
(1) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall, every five years, formulate a comprehensive plan for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital (hereinafter referred to as the "comprehensive plan") for the purpose of restoring and maintaining those sites, after hearing the opinions of the Governor of Gyeongsangbuk-do and the Mayor of Gyeongju and subsequently consulting with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies. The same shall apply when the Administrator intends to amend any important matters in the comprehensive plan prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on February 13, 2024>
(2) The comprehensive plan shall include the following matters:
1. Basic directions and objectives for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital;
2. Plans for, and implementation of, the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital;
3. Securing financial resources for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital;
4. Surveys and research concerning key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital;
5. Other matters prescribed by Presidential Decree as necessary for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital.
(3) Other matters necessary for the formulation of the comprehensive plan shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 6 (Formulation of Annual Implementation Plans, etc.)
(1) The Mayor of Gyeongju shall formulate an annual implementation plan (hereinafter referred to as an "implementation plan") in accordance with the comprehensive plan, and shall thereafter obtain approval from the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service through the Governor of Gyeongsangbuk-do. <Amended on February 13, 2024>
(2) The Mayor of Gyeongju shall evaluate the implementation results of the previous year's implementation plan and reflect the results of that evaluation in the implementation plan for the following year.
(3) Other matters necessary for the formulation of implementation plans shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Establishment and Operation of a Promotion Team)
(1) A team for promoting the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital (hereinafter referred to as the "promotion team") shall be established within the Korea Heritage Service to carry out efficiently the functions relating to the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital. <Amended on February 13, 2024>
(2) Matters necessary for the functions, composition, operation, and other aspects of the promotion team shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 8 (Restoration and Maintenance Projects)
The Government and local governments shall implement the following projects for the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital:
1. Restoration and maintenance of Wolseong;
2. Restoration and maintenance of Hwangnyongsa Temple;
3. Restoration and maintenance of Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond;
4. Restoration and maintenance of Woljeonggyo Bridge;
5. Re-excavation and exhibition of large ancient burial mounds;
6. Restoration and maintenance of the central bang (urban block) of the Silla Royal Capital;
7. Excavation and maintenance of the area surrounding Cheomseongdae Observatory;
8. Excavation and maintenance of the Jjoksaem District.

Article 9 (Reporting to the National Assembly)
The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall submit a report on the restoration and maintenance of key historic sites of the Silla Royal Capital to the competent standing committee of the National Assembly before the opening of its regular session each year. <Amended on February 13, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on May 17, 2024. However, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 4 of these Addenda, the provisions amending Acts that were promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts.
